observations: body: the line numbers 5, 10 and 20 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 159.» (L14) and «p. 160.» (L40) in the right margin; the line number 15 did not print. The 0 of the line number 30 and the 0 of the locator «p. 160.» are printed broken, like a closing parenthesis. The signature 14 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
body L1-L3, L24-L25, L34: the words from «laxis super» to «superatur.», from «partem tertiae» to «superat.» and from «id, quo» to «minor» are italic.

body L8: a thin stroke rising to the right, about 1.5 pt long, stands joined to the top of the a of «horae», like a small acute; it is not an accent of the Latin word (the printed acute over the ǵ of p. 66 is about 3.5 pt long).
body L2, L3: specks stand before «qua» and before «Oportet»; they are not signs.
body L15: the p of «paral-» is printed with a blot.
body L34: the d of «divide» is printed broken, its bowl hardly visible.
body L16, L28: a dot stands over the a of «illa», and a small nub (about 1 pt) on the top of the first a of «ascendente»; they are not accents.
body L34: a speck stands over the semicolon after «minor»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L3: the full stop after «Lunae» is printed with a short tail, a little under the baseline; read as a full stop.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
